questions.stem: A 51-year-old woman comes to the physician because of increased thirst, increased urination, and dry mouth for one month. She has a history of head trauma following a suicide attempt 3 months ago and has bipolar I disorder for which she is being treated with Lithium. She has hand tremors. Laboratory studies show a serum sodium of 151 mEq/L and an elevated antidiuretic hormone. Urine osmolality is 124 mOsm/kg H2O. Which is the most likely explanation for this patient's symptoms?

options.label: A
options.text: Hypothalamic Injury due to Head Trauma
